Name: Perimeter 81
Author: Perimeter 81
Description:
The [Perimeter 81](https://www.perimeter81.com/) Activity Logs connector sends Check Point SASE activity logs to Microsoft Sentinel using the Codeless Connector Framework (CCF) Push pattern and the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API. Events are parsed into the Perimeter81ActivityLogsV2 custom table while preserving the original payload.

**Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:**

This solution takes a dependency on the following technologies, and some of these dependencies either may be in [Preview](https://azure.microsoft.com/support/legal/preview-supplemental-terms/) state or might result in additional ingestion or operational costs:

a. [Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/logs/logs-ingestion-api-overview)

b. [Microsoft Entra ID](https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/fundamentals/what-is-entra)
WorkbookDescription: The workbook installed with the Perimeter 81 solution provide insights into login failures, application activities and network applications. After installing the solution, start using the workbook in Manage solution view.
